name: comp-364
title: User Profile Hovercard
blurb: Username link that opens a hovercard showing full profile, bio, and mutual…
description: Text link that triggers a hover card displaying avatar, full name, handle, bio, and a stack of mutual friend avatars with count.
use_when: User profile previews in discussions, mentions, or social contexts.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; requires hover to activate.
a11y: Link is keyboard-focusable; hovercard appears on hover only, not on focus.
